autohide_time.description: Time (ms) before autohiding time scale in graphs when zooming; 0 disables autohide

hide_avg_cpu.description: Hide average CPU entry in CPU chart

time_delta.description: Time change per zoom step (ms); minimum 1000 ms

default_time_value.description: Default graph time window (ms); minimum 30000 ms

dot_marker.description: Use dot marker for graphs instead of braille

expanded.description: Expand default widget on startup (ignored in basic mode)

hide_table_gap.description: Hide spacing between table headers and entries

show_table_scroll_position.description: Show scroll position tracker in table widget titles

process_current_usage.description: Calculate process CPU% as % of current usage (not total)

process_group_processes.description: Group processes with same name by default

process_memory_as_value.description: Show process memory by value (bytes) instead of percentage

process_command.description: Show full command instead of process name

process_regex.description: Enable regex in process search by default

process_tree.description: Use tree view in process widget by default

process_unnormalized_cpu.description: Show process CPU% without averaging over cores

process_whole_word.description: Enable whole-word matching in process search

cpu_left_legend.description: Position CPU chart legend on left side

memory_enable_cache.description: Enable cache and buffer memory in memory widget

network_legend_position.description: Network chart legend position (same options as memory_legend_position)

network_use_bytes.description: Display network widget in bytes (instead of bits)

network_use_binary_prefix.description: Use binary prefixes (KiB, MiB) instead of decimal (KB, MB)

network_use_log.description: Use log scale for network widget

disable_advanced_kill.description: Disable advanced process termination options (only SIGTERM)
